# brig vm-runner destroy

Destroy VMs that agents started

## Synopsis

```text
brig vm-runner destroy ID...
```

## Description

destroy powers the VMs off and deletes them with their disks and
snapshots, whichever sandbox started them.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--service string` | the vm runner service (default: the only one) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
